action.command: su - dev -c 'cd /workspace && export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH && echo "=== users ==="; docker exec ddev-tfm-fachplanung-openldap ldapsearch -x -H ldap://localhost -b "ou=people,dc=example,dc=org" "(uid=*)" uid 2>&1 | grep -E "^uid|^result"; echo "=== COUNT ==="; docker exec ddev-tfm-fachplanung-openldap ldapsearch -x -H ldap://localhost -b "ou=people,dc=example,dc=org" "(uid=*)" uid 2>&1 | grep -c "^uid:"; echo "=== seed file still present? ==="; ls -la .ddev/ldap-seed/'
